summary: Carlyle Credit Solutions filed an 8-K disclosing a board-approved Agreement and Plan of Reorganization dated September 8, 2026, to convert the Maryland corporation into New Carlyle Credit Solutions, a newly formed Delaware statutory trust electing BDC status under the 1940 Act. Stockholders would receive one Successor Fund share of the same class per Company share, with aggregate NAV preserved; the same adviser, management team, objective and portfolio carry over. The transaction requires stockholder approval. No price, premium or cash consideration applies — the key angle is the shareholder vote and any appraisal or dissenting-holder friction.
